Non-alcoholic beverages with natural or artificial sweeteners, and flavored or carbonated water: soda, sweetened tea, energy drinks, sports drinks. Excludes drinks with milk or milk substitutes, or over 50% fruit or vegetable juice, which are groceries (food.grocery).
conditions: {"note": "Soft drinks are food for domestic home consumption, exempt from state and local tax (39-15-105)."}

category_description: Consumer electronics and their accessories: computers, phones, tablets, TVs, cameras, headphones, smart home devices, cables and chargers.
Furniture and home furnishings: tables, chairs, sofas, beds, mattresses, desks, shelving and office furniture.

General merchandise: any physical product with no more specific category, such as housewares, toys, sporting goods, tools, decor, cosmetics, toiletries, pet supplies and gifts. Use this for a tangible item, or a generic retail or merchandise line, when no other category fits.
Infant/baby diapers and adult incontinence products (briefs, liners, underpads), cloth or disposable.
Menstrual and feminine hygiene products: tampons, sanitary pads, pantyliners, menstrual cups, and period underwear.
Wheelchairs, hearing aids, prosthetics, durable medical equipment.
conditions: {"note": "DME and prosthetics exempt when prescribed (Wyo. Stat. 39-15-105).", "prescription_required": true}

category_description: Over-the-counter drugs sold with a Drug Facts label: pain relievers, cold and allergy medicine, antacids, medicated creams, sunscreen. Products with a Supplement Facts label are food.dietary_supplements.
conditions: {"note": "OTC taxable unless dispensed by prescription."}

category_description: Prescription drugs (typically exempt nationwide).
Printed books for general readers: fiction, non-fiction, cookbooks, children's books. E-books and audiobooks are digital.download; required course textbooks are publications.textbooks.
Printed magazines and periodicals, single copies or subscriptions.
Printed newspapers, single copies or subscriptions.
Required course and college textbooks, printed or digital, as distinct from general trade books. Many states exempt these only when sold by a school or to an enrolled student.
Metered access to AI models through an API, billed per token, request or compute unit.
conditions: {"note": "Wyoming taxes services only where 39-15-103 lists them, and remote software or API access is not listed. Digital products are taxed only with permanent use. category_description: Data processing and information services: collecting, storing, processing or retrieving data for a customer, data feeds, credit reports, payroll processing, online storage.
Services performed on a person: haircuts, salon and spa services, massage, nails, tanning, tattooing.
Professional services where the customer buys expertise or advice rather than a product: legal, accounting, bookkeeping, consulting, design, engineering, marketing, implementation and training.
Labor to repair, maintain or install tangible property: appliance, vehicle, electronics and equipment repair, servicing and maintenance.
Web hosting and related infrastructure: website hosting, domain registration, server and storage space, website plans billed as hosting.
Software written for one specific customer to its own specifications. Off-the-shelf software configured for a customer is not custom.
Off-the-shelf (canned) software the customer installs: downloaded programs and apps, software on disc, operating systems, and licences or updates for installed software.
Software as a Service: off-the-shelf software the customer uses over the internet without installing a copy, usually by subscription. Includes web apps and online platforms.
conditions: {"note": "Wyoming taxes services only where 39-15-103 lists them, and remote software access is not listed.
